clusters.claim: Winners write the next round's rule (the token of power; rules for their own kind)
clusters.why: All rest on ReadsShare, which the record itself calls the premise where 'the winner shapes the rule' enters; the sources asserting it of actual societies are scope, so wamo-selection-filter (same 2024-07-14 sentence as asc-token-same-shape) goes to scope. archearth stays agreement: its source is a hedged should with no universal to correct. Thrasymachus is fresh-reading as a domain the account was not formed from.

clusters.claim: Compounding advantage: success buys the means to win again
clusters.why: Meadows's 'winners eventually take all' is stated of the structure generally and the targets condition it (premise, no noise, drift leaves), so syscyb goes to scope with wamo-matthew and sspiral-winner. kpso keeps agreement: its own source says it runs away only where returns increase. Merton keeps agreement of reading: only the generalized form has a shape.

clusters.claim: Partial reform is re-absorbed; only a change of law, reading or selection leaves
clusters.why: All scope, each citing the absorption theorem with the reversal witness as the correction of a universal; fork and kpso already linked by same_as.

clusters.claim: Criticism is absorbed only under four conditions, otherwise effective counter-selection
clusters.why: One sentence of one source (CHAIN/v6 main-zh.md) given carried-in-part/scope in ma and fresh-reading/divergence in zhishan. The source is already conditional, so scope has nothing to correct, and ma's own reading says 'None sorts a given criticism by the source's four tests'. zhishan's verdict holds for both.

clusters.claim: A reading formed from the share absorbs any change of it (minds, paradigms, adapted preferences, owned discourse)
clusters.why: The theorem is near-definitional (a reading that is a function of the share is undone when re-read) and the record says readers being minds is a reading; so a join to minds is agreement of reading, as kpso, Sen and wamo-memetic have it. drives-inescapable-basin goes from law to reading. The universal claims (minds-first, worshipper, narrative, discourse, conceptual) are scope. 08's warning applies: this law read onto a dozen sources explains little by itself.

clusters.claim: A lock outlives a loss it does not read
clusters.why: Relations hold, with scope where a universal is conditioned and divergence where the source's loss is read (Fisher, Hegel). Three entries cite lock_outlives_loss as carrying where their own reading says the subject or the premises fail (pal, hegel) or that it runs the other way (sspiral-dominance): those roles go to neighbour.

clusters.claim: A way out: a reading of what the share does not carry (dissent, prophets, schools, ledgers, correction)
clusters.why: Prescriptions stated generally are scope against 'a sufficient way out, not shown necessary'; kpso-correction-keystone, which defines catastrophe across any harm and has one condition's margin on a model as its live form, goes to scope with them. Narratives and designs that state no universal (prophets, Ashby, sealed adjudication) keep agreement of reading: a real difference.

clusters.claim: The corpus's meta-attractor as a wider object than the account's
clusters.why: Where the account narrows the object by decision (GLOSSARY: never the corpus's working sense) nothing universal is conditioned: ma-complete-object has divergence and zhishan-totalizing goes there too. sspiral-attractor-no-subject, asc-four-layer-loop and ma-scale-isomorphism state a dynamic or its reach universally and stay scope.

clusters.claim: Meadows's leverage hierarchy, paradigm at the top
clusters.why: syscyb maps the ranking itself (divergence: no law ranks). fork and sspiral map the exit clause, read against the closed-capture way out (scope), and put the missing ranking in source_adds.

clusters.claim: Commercial selection reaches the training objective
clusters.why: Both say the route from revenue to a loss is not stated. kpso's carried-in-part rests on 07's assessment of published pipelines, a live sentence on training signals, which asc does not cite. A thin difference, and not one about the capture targets.

clusters.claim: A counter-rule locks as the rule it replaced (D68), and a threshold reading need not lock
clusters.why: All scope, read by descent from the meta-attractor line and corrected by the Lean witness Alternating.never_locked.

clusters.claim: The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not what it favours
clusters.why: One target sentence; the sources say opposite things (direction-neutral agrees in form, the good/evil asymmetry diverges), and the folder's own tension is kept in both entries.
Consistent: loop shape as agreement of reading through capture-through-the-rule, and divergence from closed capture because cost enters the counts and Unread fails.

clusters.claim: Structure or configuration decides, so a change of law leaves
clusters.why: Scope where a universal is conditioned. Eroding goals is agreement of reading on the downward lock witness, its cause put in source_adds.

clusters.claim: Capture targets cited as neighbours only
clusters.why: No connection rests on these targets except the MMK contrary reading and sty's D45 reading, both apt. Stigler's agreement rests on the shaping and drawn-reader records and belongs to that cluster.

rulings.why: Same claim 85 and source as zhishan's claim 52. The source is already conditional ('only when'), so scope corrects nothing. Its own reading says no live text sorts a criticism by the four tests, so no sentence states a part. The law's 'absorbed' is a perturbation undone, not criticism taken up as capability, so closed-capture is a neighbour, as in cx-zhishan-criticism-absorbed.
The same sentence of the same corpus file (CHAIN/v6 main-zh.md) is mapped in meta-attractor claim 85, so a total should count it once.

Its own reading says 'The source asserts its filter of societies; that ... winners shape the rule, the record does not show'. That is a universal conditioned by ReadsShare as premise. The same 2024-07-14 sentence (out-hb-01 #92) is cx-asc-token-same-shape, which has scope.
Its claim 12 and wamo's claim 89 cite one source note (out-hb-01.md #92, 2024-07-14) for the token-of-power filter.

The archetype says winners eventually take all, stated generally of the structure. The targets condition it: ReadsShare is the premise, there is no noise, drift leaves either lock, and full taking excludes only under 05's premises. Its siblings cx-wamo-matthew-externality and cx-sspiral-winner-justifies-all are scope. cx-kpso-compounding-axis keeps agreement only because its source conditions itself on increasing returns.

The law's subject is a rule's reading monotone in a share, while the source's is a mind's method of assessment. The reading itself keeps 'whether minds meet them' apart, and the closed-capture record says readers being minds is a reading. Two carriers are D65 readings. The like joins cx-kpso-paradigm-coherence, cx-modphil-sen-adaptive-preferences and cx-wamo-memetic-capture are agreement of reading.

Its source_adds says the source defines catastrophe 'across any harm by time-constants, where the live form is one condition's margin on a model'. The closed-capture exit is 'sufficient and not shown necessary'. Like prescriptions (cx-rsd-rebuild-feedbacks, cx-zhishan-trust-dissent) are scope. This entry mainly belongs to the reader-margin cluster (one-reader-several-conditions).

Its reading cites lock_outlives_loss as what 'runs the other way' from the source's 'loss of contact with reality'. The agreement rests on relative-position-is-zero-sum and where-a-rising-take-ends, not on closed-capture.

Its reading says 'His bondsman does come to read, so these premises do not catch him'. The divergence rests on the absence of any law of contradiction moving a relation (T7 and the search), not on a law whose premises the source fails.
Its reading says 'the source's object is one goal kept, the law's a rule read from a share'. The condition it gives comes from 02's 'Which locks noise leaves' reading, which carries.

Its reading says the account narrows the word to a model and the word never means the corpus's wider sense. The standing differs as well: the source declines a mathematical object and the account defines one. That is a divergence of object, as cx-ma-complete-object has it, and no universal of the source's is conditioned.

live_flags.what: It says 'Goodhart (1975) says a measure made a target stops measuring'. Goodhart's 1975 statement is that a statistical regularity collapses once pressure is placed on it for control. The 'measure made a target' wording is Strathern's 1997 gloss, as cx-econ-goodhart-regularity flags. A reader is told the later wording is Goodhart's.

The clause 'a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step', where the reading is formed monotonically from the share, is cited by about a dozen crosswalk entries about minds and paradigms. It is close to definitional, and the home gives it no standing note. 08 on near-definitional laws would have the home or the record say so, so that fronts do not cite it as a finding about minds.
